blocks.zh: Topic 5：可比較性研究
blocks.en: Topic 5: Comparability Studies

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 區分 Bridging（銜接研究）與 Comparability（可比較性研究）的定義、目的與適用場合
blocks.en: Distinguish the definition, purpose and applicable situations of bridging studies and comparability studies

blocks.zh: 掌握三層次可比較性框架：批次放行測試、特性測試、穩定性可比較性，並理解各層次的嚴謹度要求
blocks.en: Master the three-level comparability framework (lot-release testing, characterization testing, and stability comparability), and understand the rigor required at each level

blocks.zh: 識別 ATMP 產品在可比較性研究中面臨的獨特挑戰（樣本量有限、分析方法仍在發展中）
blocks.en: Identify the unique challenges ATMP products face in comparability studies (limited sample quantity, analytical methods still under development)

blocks.zh: 了解在比較性協議執行期間需要變更測試方法時，方法銜接（Method Bridging）的實施方法與注意事項
blocks.en: Understand how to implement method bridging, and what to watch for, when test methods must be changed during execution of a comparability protocol

blocks.zh: Q 5.1 — How are bridging studies different from comparability studies? Q 5.1 — 銜接性研究與可比性研究有何不同？
blocks.en: Q 5.1 - How are bridging studies different from comparability studies?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Bridging（銜接）= 時代翻譯辭典
blocks.en: Bridging = a dictionary that translates across eras

blocks.zh: 想像你用1980年代的老字典查了一個詞，但現在這個詞的定義已經更新了。「Bridging」就像是把舊版辭典和新版辭典的定義對照起來，確認當年查到的意思在今天仍然成立——過去的穩定性數據、參考標準測試結果，都需要這樣的「翻譯」才能在今日仍被接受。
blocks.en: Imagine you looked up a word in an old 1980s dictionary, but the definition of that word has since been updated. "Bridging" is like lining up the definitions in the old and new dictionaries to confirm that the meaning you found back then still holds today. Past stability data and reference standard test results all need this kind of "translation" to remain acceptable today.

blocks.zh: Comparability（可比較性）= 兩款葡萄酒的盲測對比
blocks.en: Comparability = a blind side-by-side tasting of two wines

blocks.zh: 同一個酒莊，在兩個不同年份（或不同國家的分廠）生產的葡萄酒，拿來並排品嚐，看看是不是同樣的品質與風味。這就是 Comparability——同時比對兩批來自不同條件的產品，確認等效性。
blocks.en: The same winery produces wine in two different vintages (or at two plants in different countries), and you taste them side by side to see whether the quality and flavor are the same. That is comparability: comparing two batches of product made under different conditions at the same time, to confirm equivalence.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：穩定性銜接計畫必須「事前」制定
blocks.en: Key Point: The Stability Bridging Plan Must Be Drawn Up in Advance

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調："before the change is implemented"（在變更實施之前）就必須規劃好穩定性數據的銜接策略。
blocks.en: The source text specifically stresses that the stability data bridging strategy must be planned "before the change is implemented".

blocks.zh: 這是業界最常犯的錯誤之一：等到分析方法已經升級、新版參考標準已經啟用，才意識到過去三年的穩定性時間點數據無法與新方法連貫。此時已無法補救——舊批次可能已經超出保存期限或樣本耗盡，銜接研究根本無從進行。
blocks.en: This is one of the most common mistakes in the industry: only after the analytical method has been upgraded and the new reference standard put into use does the team realize that the stability time-point data of the past three years cannot be linked to the new method. By then it is too late to fix: the old batches may have exceeded their shelf life or the samples may be used up, so a bridging study cannot be done at all.

blocks.zh: 實務結論：方法變更或參考標準更新前，變更控制文件中必須包含「穩定性銜接計畫」章節。
blocks.en: Practical conclusion: before a method change or reference standard update, the change control document must include a "stability bridging plan" section.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 保留樣本庫管理策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: Retention Sample Inventory Management Strategy at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，管理客戶的保留樣本（retention samples）庫存是一項高價值、高風險的業務。以下是建議的管理策略：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, managing a client's retention sample inventory is a high-value, high-risk activity. The following management strategies are recommended:

blocks.zh: 臨床批次清單（Clinical Lot Inventory）：建立專用台帳，記錄每個臨床批次的樣本位置、剩餘量、有效期限、已進行的測試版本
blocks.en: Clinical Lot Inventory: Set up a dedicated register recording, for each clinical batch, the sample location, remaining quantity, expiry date, and the test versions already performed

blocks.zh: 參考標準版本追蹤：每個批次的 CoA 應標記當時使用的參考標準版本號，並在 LIMS 系統中建立版本-批次對照關係
blocks.en: Reference standard version tracking: The CoA of each batch should state the reference standard version used at the time, and a version-to-batch cross-reference should be established in the LIMS

blocks.zh: 分析方法版本對應表：維護一份「哪些批次用哪個版本的方法測試」的矩陣表，確保方法升級後可以快速識別哪些批次需要補做銜接研究
blocks.en: Analytical method version mapping table: Maintain a matrix of which batches were tested with which method version, so that after a method upgrade it is quick to identify which batches need a bridging study

blocks.zh: SOP 明文規定：什麼情況下 CoA 需要更新、什麼情況下加注版本說明即可，避免不同 QA 人員對此有不同解讀
blocks.en: Explicit SOP provisions: Define when a CoA needs to be reissued and when it is enough to add a version note, to avoid different QA staff interpreting this differently

blocks.zh: 保留樣本使用審批：每次動用保留樣本庫必須有書面協議，說明使用目的、剩餘量預測、補充計畫
blocks.en: Approval for use of retention samples: Every draw on the retention sample inventory needs a written protocol stating the purpose of use, projected remaining quantity, and replenishment plan

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：Bridging vs. Comparability
blocks.en: Core Concept: Bridging vs. Comparability

blocks.zh: 這兩個術語在業界常被混用，但有明確的概念區別：
blocks.en: These two terms are often used interchangeably in industry, but there is a clear conceptual distinction:

blocks.zh: ICH Q5E 的「可比較性銜接研究」（comparability bridging study）是兩者的結合：先用可比較性確認等效性，再用銜接研究允許外推先前的非臨床/臨床數據。
blocks.en: The "comparability bridging study" of ICH Q5E combines the two: comparability is used first to confirm equivalence, and the bridging study then allows extrapolation of prior nonclinical/clinical data.

blocks.zh: Q 5.2 — How can a change control strategy compare or utilize test results from two sites, two batches, or clinical to PPQ material? Q 5.2 — 變更控制策略如何比較或利用來自兩個廠區、兩個批次或臨床至 PPQ 物料的測試結果？
blocks.en: Q 5.2 - How can a change control strategy compare or utilize test results from two sites, two batches, or clinical to PPQ material?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三層次可比較性框架
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three-Level Comparability Framework

blocks.zh: ICH Q5E 框架下，分析可比較性分為三個遞進層次，嚴謹度逐層提升：
blocks.en: Under the ICH Q5E framework, analytical comparability has three progressive levels, with rigor increasing at each level:

blocks.zh:
Level 3：穩定性可比較性（Stability Comparability）
包含加速穩定性與強制降解研究，確認貨架期仍可適用
blocks.en:
Level 3: Stability Comparability
Includes accelerated stability and forced degradation studies, confirming that the shelf life still applies

blocks.zh: ▲ 最嚴謹
blocks.en: ▲ Most rigorous

blocks.zh:
Level 2：特性測試（Characterization Testing）
批次放行規格以外的深度特性分析，偵測隱藏的品質屬性變化
blocks.en:
Level 2: Characterization Testing
In-depth characterization beyond the lot-release specifications, to detect hidden changes in quality attributes

blocks.zh:
Level 1：批次放行測試（Lot-Release Testing）
以歷史數據為基準，設定比放行規格更嚴的可比較性標準
blocks.en:
Level 1: Lot-Release Testing
Based on historical data, with comparability criteria set tighter than the release specification

blocks.zh: ▲ 基礎層次
blocks.en: ▲ Foundation level

blocks.zh: 關鍵要點：Level 1 的可比較性標準通常比放行規格（release specification）更嚴，因為它的目的是偵測製程差異，而非僅判斷產品是否合格。
blocks.en: Key point: The Level 1 comparability criteria are usually tighter than the release specification, because their purpose is to detect process differences, not merely to judge whether the product passes.

blocks.zh: 三層次框架 = 汽車出廠安全驗證的三道關卡
blocks.en: The three-level framework = the three checkpoints of vehicle safety certification before a car leaves the factory

blocks.zh: Level 1（批次放行）= 出廠前的標準安全檢查，確認轉向、煞車等基本功能合格——但這只是最低門檻。Level 2（特性測試）= 更全面的工程檢測，包含震動測試、材質疲勞分析，找出標準檢查看不到的潛在問題。Level 3（穩定性）= 長期道路模擬測試，確認這輛車五年後的可靠度和新車一樣——對應的是「加速穩定性」的「壓力測試」概念。三道關卡都通過，才算真正可比較。
blocks.en: Level 1 (lot release) = the standard pre-delivery safety check, confirming that basics such as steering and brakes work, but this is only the minimum threshold. Level 2 (characterization testing) = more comprehensive engineering tests, including vibration testing and material fatigue analysis, to find latent problems the standard check cannot see. Level 3 (stability) = a long-term road simulation test, confirming that the car will be as reliable five years later as when new, which corresponds to the "stress test" concept of accelerated stability. Only when all three checkpoints are passed is it truly comparable.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ATMP 樣本稀缺的獨特挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: The Unique Challenge of Scarce ATMP Samples

blocks.zh: ATMP（先進治療製藥）的可比較性研究面臨一個傳統生物製藥沒有的根本性挑戰：樣本量極為有限。
blocks.en: Comparability studies for ATMPs (advanced therapy medicinal products) face a fundamental challenge that conventional biopharmaceuticals do not: extremely limited sample quantity.

blocks.zh: 對於一個罕見疾病基因治療產品，早期 Phase I 可能只生產了 2–3 批，每批只有幾瓶。這些有限的樣本要同時支撐：分析方法開發、參考標準建立、穩定性研究、臨床前毒理研究，再加上可比較性測試——根本不夠用。
blocks.en: For a rare-disease gene therapy product, only 2-3 batches may have been produced in early Phase I, with just a few vials per batch. These limited samples must support analytical method development, reference standard establishment, stability studies and nonclinical toxicology studies, in addition to comparability testing, which is simply not enough.

blocks.zh: 業界的應對策略包括：
blocks.en: Industry coping strategies include:

blocks.zh: 採用 charge detection mass spectrometry（電荷偵測質譜儀） 等微量消耗技術
blocks.en: Use low-consumption techniques such as charge detection mass spectrometry

blocks.zh: 增加同一樣本的重複測試次數，用統計方法彌補批次數不足
blocks.en: Increase the number of replicate tests on the same sample, using statistical methods to compensate for the small number of batches

blocks.zh: 早期建立 assay control（分析方法管控品），作為跨時間點比較的橋樑
blocks.en: Establish an assay control early, as a bridge for comparison across time points

blocks.zh: 實務應用：側邊並行測試的執行細節
blocks.en: Practical Application: Details of Executing Side-by-Side Testing

blocks.zh: 「同板、同試劑、同時段」是可比較性測試的黃金準則，具體落實方法：
blocks.en: "Same plate, same reagents, same time" is the golden rule of comparability testing. In practice:

blocks.zh: 同一個 run/plate/sequence：將變更前後的樣本放在同一塊 ELISA 板或同一次質譜分析序列中，消除批間試劑差異和儀器漂移
blocks.en: Same run/plate/sequence: Place the pre-change and post-change samples on the same ELISA plate or in the same mass spectrometry sequence, eliminating run-to-run reagent differences and instrument drift

blocks.zh: 樣本分板技巧：若一塊板放不下所有樣本，將兩個樣本「各取一半」分放在兩塊板上，而非一個樣本佔一整塊板——這樣即使有板間差異，兩個樣本所受的影響是對稱的
blocks.en: Sample plate-splitting technique: If one plate cannot hold all the samples, split each of the two samples across two plates (half on each), rather than putting one sample on an entire plate. That way, even if there is plate-to-plate variation, both samples are affected symmetrically

blocks.zh: 關鍵試劑批次管控：尤其是抗體、細胞株等關鍵試劑，提前預留足夠的同批次量用於整個可比較性研究周期，避免途中試劑批次更換引入額外變因
blocks.en: Critical reagent lot control: For critical reagents such as antibodies and cell lines in particular, reserve enough of the same lot in advance for the whole comparability study period, to avoid introducing extra variables from a lot change midway

blocks.zh: 無法同板時的替代方案：在新批次測試中，加入歷史參考標準或 assay control，監測 assay drift（分析漂移），並定量計算漂移對測試結果的影響
blocks.en: Alternative when same-plate testing is not possible: Include a historical reference standard or assay control in the new batch's testing to monitor assay drift, and quantitatively calculate the effect of the drift on the test results

blocks.zh: 重點提示：BLA 審查風險——樞紐性比較失敗的後果
blocks.en: Key Point: BLA Review Risk - The Consequences of a Failed Pivotal Comparison

blocks.zh: 原文特別提醒：即使是最完善的可比較性評估，也無法完全排除監管機構在後期要求體內評估（in vivo assessment）的風險。
blocks.en: The source text specifically warns that even the most thorough comparability assessment cannot fully eliminate the risk that regulators will later request an in vivo assessment.

blocks.zh: 更嚴重的情況是：如果 pivotal clinical（樞紐性臨床）批次與 PPQ（製程效能確認）批次之間的可比較性未能充分建立，BLA 審查過程中監管機構可能要求：
blocks.en: A more serious situation: if comparability between pivotal clinical batches and PPQ (process performance qualification) batches is not adequately established, regulators may request the following during BLA review:

blocks.zh: 補充橋接臨床試驗（bridging clinical study）——可能延誤上市一到兩年
blocks.en: A supplementary bridging clinical study, which may delay the launch by one to two years

blocks.zh: 修訂規格（release specification）——需要重新提交技術文件
blocks.en: Revision of the release specification, requiring resubmission of technical documentation

blocks.zh: 在核准條件附加上市後承諾（post-approval commitment）
blocks.en: A post-approval commitment attached to the approval conditions

blocks.zh: 結論：可比較性研究的投資回報率（ROI）極高——前期投入充分的可比較性計畫，遠比事後補救節省時間和成本。
blocks.en: Conclusion: the return on investment (ROI) of comparability studies is very high; investing adequately in a comparability plan up front saves far more time and cost than remediating afterwards.

blocks.zh: Q 5.3 — What approaches can be used when it is necessary to change test methods during a comparability protocol? Q 5.3 — 在可比性方案中需要變更測試方法時可採用哪些做法？
blocks.en: Q 5.3 - What approaches can be used when it is necessary to change test methods during a comparability protocol?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：方法銜接（Method Bridging）的運作機制
blocks.en: Core Concept: How Method Bridging Works

blocks.zh: 方法銜接的本質是：用一組「共同樣本集」作為橋樑，連接舊方法與新方法的結果空間。執行步驟如下：
blocks.en: The essence of method bridging is to use a "common sample set" as a bridge connecting the result spaces of the old and new methods. The steps are:

blocks.zh: 選擇橋接樣本集：應包含代表性的多種樣本類型——高、中、低值樣本；不同批次；穩定性樣本（尤其重要）
blocks.en: Select the bridging sample set: It should include a representative variety of sample types: high, mid and low value samples; different batches; and stability samples (especially important)

blocks.zh: 同期雙軌測試：同一組樣本，同時用舊方法和新方法測試，取得配對數據
blocks.en: Parallel testing: Test the same set of samples with both the old and new methods at the same time, to obtain paired data

blocks.zh: 計算方法偏差（Method Bias）：統計分析兩種方法的系統性偏差（bias）和精度差異
blocks.en: Calculate method bias: Statistically analyze the systematic bias and the difference in precision between the two methods

blocks.zh: 評估影響範圍：評估該 bias 對放行規格、穩定性規格、可比較性判定標準的影響
blocks.en: Assess the scope of impact: Evaluate the effect of the bias on the release specification, the stability specification, and the comparability acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 更新控制策略：如需要，調整相應的驗收標準，並在文件中記錄 bias 的大小和方向
blocks.en: Update the control strategy: If needed, adjust the corresponding acceptance criteria, and document the size and direction of the bias

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：方法之間存在 bias 是可以接受的，但必須是已充分定性（well-characterized）的 bias，而非未知的不確定性。
blocks.en: Key principle: a bias between methods is acceptable, but it must be a well-characterized bias, not an unknown uncertainty.

blocks.zh: 歷史穩定性樣本 = 在酒瓶中慢慢變化的老酒
blocks.en: Historical stability samples = old wine slowly changing in the bottle

blocks.zh: 想像你封存了一瓶葡萄酒，打算五年後再品嚐，看它是否還和五年前一樣。但問題是：即使你什麼都沒改變，酒本身在瓶中也會繼續演化——單寧軟化、香氣改變。當五年後你用新的品酒技術重新分析它，差異到底來自「品酒技術改變」，還是「酒本身在瓶中的自然演化」？
blocks.en: Imagine you seal a bottle of wine, planning to taste it five years later to see whether it is still the same as five years ago. The problem is that even if you change nothing, the wine itself keeps evolving in the bottle: the tannins soften and the aroma changes. When you re-analyze it five years later with a new tasting technique, does the difference come from the "change in tasting technique" or from the "natural evolution of the wine in the bottle"?

blocks.zh: ATMP 的歷史穩定性樣本面臨同樣的問題：長期冷凍保存也會造成輕微的樣本降解。因此在用歷史樣本進行方法銜接時，必須先扣除「儲存效應（storage effect）」，才能正確歸因差異的來源。
blocks.en: Historical stability samples of ATMPs face the same problem: long-term frozen storage also causes slight sample degradation. Therefore, when using historical samples for method bridging, the "storage effect" must first be subtracted, so that the source of the difference can be attributed correctly.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：平台方法作為保留樣本匱乏的替代方案
blocks.en: Key Point: A Platform Approach as an Alternative When Retention Samples Are Scarce

blocks.zh: 當 ATMP 保留樣本完全不足以支撐方法銜接研究時，平台方法（platform approach）提供了一個實用的替代策略：
blocks.en: When ATMP retention samples are completely inadequate to support a method bridging study, a platform approach offers a practical alternative strategy:

blocks.zh: 核心思路：對於「產品非依賴性」的分析項目，可以用「不同產品但相同平台」的樣本作為銜接研究的代理材料。
blocks.en: Core idea: For "product-independent" analytical attributes, samples of a "different product on the same platform" can serve as surrogate material for the bridging study.

blocks.zh: 適用例子：
blocks.en: Examples of applicability:

blocks.zh: 宿主細胞蛋白質（Host Cell Protein, HCP）檢測：如果兩個不同的 AAV 產品都使用 HEK293 細胞作為生產系統，其中一個產品的 HCP 標準品可以為另一個產品的 HCP 方法銜接提供代理樣本
blocks.en: Host cell protein (HCP) testing: If two different AAV products both use HEK293 cells as the production system, the HCP standard of one product can provide surrogate samples for HCP method bridging of the other

blocks.zh: 宿主細胞 DNA（Residual Host Cell DNA）檢測：使用相同細胞株來源的 DNA 樣本，可以作為不同產品的共用方法銜接材料
blocks.en: Residual host cell DNA testing: DNA samples from the same cell line source can serve as shared method bridging material for different products

blocks.zh: 限制與注意事項：這個替代方案僅適用於「方法性能驗證」目的，不能用於替代針對具體產品特性的可比較性結論。監管機構的接受度需要個案評估。
blocks.en: Limitations and cautions: This alternative applies only to the purpose of "method performance verification" and cannot replace comparability conclusions that depend on specific product characteristics. Regulatory acceptance needs to be assessed case by case.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：黃金法則——不要同時改變方法與製程
blocks.en: Key Point: The Golden Rule - Do Not Change the Method and the Process at the Same Time

blocks.zh: 原文明確提出：「it is undesirable to change both the methods and the attribute to be studied for comparability」
blocks.en: The source text states explicitly: "it is undesirable to change both the methods and the attribute to be studied for comparability"

blocks.zh: 這是一條黃金法則，其背後邏輯是：
blocks.en: This is a golden rule, and the logic behind it is:

blocks.zh: 如果在可比較性研究進行中，你同時改變了「被比較的製程/廠址」以及「用於比較的分析方法」，那麼觀察到的任何差異就無法明確歸因——是製程差異造成的？還是方法差異造成的？兩者交絡（confounded），可比較性結論就失去說服力。
blocks.en: If, during a comparability study, you change both the "process/site being compared" and the "analytical method used for the comparison", then any difference observed cannot be clearly attributed: is it caused by the process difference, or by the method difference? The two are confounded, and the comparability conclusion loses its persuasiveness.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：如果製程變更與方法升級不得不同時發生，先完成方法銜接（method bridging），建立舊/新方法的等效性關係，再開始製程可比較性評估。這樣即使方法不同，也能通過已知的 bias 關係將結果換算到同一基準。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: If the process change and the method upgrade must happen at the same time, complete method bridging first, to establish the equivalence relationship between the old and new methods, and only then begin the process comparability assessment. That way, even though the methods differ, the results can be converted to a common basis through the known bias relationship.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 以下練習題供自我評估，涵蓋本章 Q5.1–Q5.3 的核心概念。
blocks.en: The following practice questions are for self-assessment and cover the core concepts of Q5.1-Q5.3 in this chapter.

blocks.zh: 概念辨別：一家 CDMO 正在協助客戶將 AAV 載體生產從 A 廠址遷移到 B 廠址，同時分析部門也計畫在同一時期升級效價測試方法（舊 ELISA → 新數位 PCR）。請問從可比較性研究的角度，這樣的安排存在什麼問題？建議的處理順序是什麼？
blocks.en: Concept discrimination: A CDMO is helping a client transfer AAV vector production from Site A to Site B, while the analytical department also plans to upgrade the potency test method (old ELISA → new digital PCR) in the same period. From the perspective of a comparability study, what is wrong with this arrangement? What sequence of actions do you recommend?

blocks.zh: 三層次應用：一個 lentiviral vector 產品完成了 Phase II 臨床試驗後，製造商決定將生物反應器規模從 50L 擴大到 200L。請描述完整的三層次分析可比較性評估計畫，包括每個層次應包含哪些測試項目，以及最終目標是什麼（支持什麼監管決策）？
blocks.en: Applying the three levels: After a lentiviral vector product completes Phase II clinical trials, the manufacturer decides to scale the bioreactor up from 50 L to 200 L. Describe a complete three-level analytical comparability assessment plan, including which tests each level should contain, and what the final objective is (which regulatory decision it supports)?

blocks.zh: 實務挑戰：一個罕見遺傳疾病基因治療產品在 Phase I 階段只生產了 2 批，每批只保留了 3 支 1mL 的樣本管。現在需要進行方法銜接研究（舊版基因拷貝數 PCR vs. 新版 ddPCR），但 2 批樣本加起來只有 6 支——遠不夠同時支撐穩定性研究和方法銜接研究。你會如何解決這個資源衝突？請列舉至少 2 種策略，並說明各自的限制。
blocks.en: Practical challenge: A rare genetic disease gene therapy product produced only 2 batches in Phase I, and only 3 sample tubes of 1 mL were retained per batch. A method bridging study (old gene copy number PCR vs. new ddPCR) is now needed, but the 2 batches together have only 6 tubes, far from enough to support both the stability study and the method bridging study. How would you resolve this resource conflict? List at least 2 strategies and explain the limitations of each.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Bridging（銜接）vs. Comparability（可比較性）：前者是縱向的數據延續性確認，後者是橫向的等效性比較；ICH Q5E 的「comparability bridging study」是兩者的結合應用
blocks.en: Bridging vs. Comparability: The former is a longitudinal confirmation of data continuity, the latter a lateral comparison of equivalence; the "comparability bridging study" of ICH Q5E applies the two in combination

blocks.zh: 穩定性銜接計畫必須事前制定：方法或參考標準更新的變更控制文件中，必須包含穩定性數據銜接策略，事後補救往往已無可用樣本
blocks.en: The stability bridging plan must be drawn up in advance: The change control document for a method or reference standard update must include the stability data bridging strategy; remediation afterwards often finds no samples left to use

blocks.zh: 三層次可比較性框架：批次放行測試（Level 1）→ 特性測試（Level 2）→ 穩定性可比較性（Level 3），嚴謹度隨開發階段和法規需求逐步提升
blocks.en: The three-level comparability framework: Lot-release testing (Level 1) → characterization testing (Level 2) → stability comparability (Level 3), with rigor increasing progressively with development stage and regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: ATMP 獨特挑戰：樣本量極為有限，需採用微量消耗技術（如 charge detection MS）、側邊並行測試（same plate/same reagent lot）等策略降低分析變異
blocks.en: Unique ATMP challenges: Sample quantity is extremely limited, so strategies such as low-consumption techniques (e.g., charge detection MS) and side-by-side testing (same plate/same reagent lot) are needed to reduce analytical variability

blocks.zh: 方法銜接的黃金法則：避免同時改變製程與測試方法；若不得已，先完成方法銜接並定性 bias，再進行製程可比較性評估；保留樣本匱乏時，可考慮相同平台的不同產品作為代理材料
blocks.en: The golden rule of method bridging: Avoid changing the process and the test method at the same time; if unavoidable, complete method bridging and characterize the bias first, then perform the process comparability assessment; when retention samples are scarce, consider different products on the same platform as surrogate material

blocks.zh: 歷史穩定性樣本的解讀注意事項：長期儲存本身會造成樣本降解，必須在歸因方法差異之前先排除儲存效應的影響
blocks.en: Cautions in interpreting historical stability samples: Long-term storage itself causes sample degradation, so the effect of storage must be excluded before attributing differences to the method
